description: Scam Message Checker evaluation set. Every message is fictional and written for this evaluation: domains are example.com-style or obviously fake, numbers are dummy (90000 00000-style, 198.51.100.x / 203.0.113.x documentation IPs). No real person's number or real scam link is used. 'label' is scam or genuine; 'expected_type' uses scam_checker.SCAM_TYPES.
